description: Promote a parked idea to a Campaign (to=campaign) or an Articles entry (to=entry). Optional name for a Campaign; omitted uses the first line of the idea. Side effect: writes Campaign or Articles state and marks the idea promoted. Needs write scope. Not idempotent.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A string you generate once per intended action (a UUID is good) and repeat on retry. A retry with the same key and arguments returns the first result instead of acting twice; the same key with different arguments is refused. Kept 24 hours.

name.description: to=campaign: Campaign name; defaults to the idea's first line.

to.description: campaign or entry: what the idea becomes.

type.description: to=entry: Articles type, for example decision (default) or fact.

name: promote_idea
title: Promote idea
